hero.tagline: From our vineyard to your table.
house.statement: Wine does not begin in the bottle. It begins with a place.
house.support: VARVI wines are made in Cricău, in Alba, at the heart of Transylvania's historic wine country, by Casa de vinuri Maria, a house that works at a scale where each bottling can be counted.
flag.copy: A Romanian grape. A Transylvanian expression. The 2024 Fetească Neagră was bottled in a single limited edition of 1,200 bottles.
col.title: The VARVI Collection
cert.note: [ award certificate to be supplied, placeholder shown ]
place.title: Transylvania
place.copy: Hills, forest, cold mornings and long autumns, in Transylvania's historic wine country. The place is the wine's first ingredient.
origin.caption: where the wines are made
limited.title: Not made by the million.
limited.copy: VARVI wines are bottled in limited editions, sometimes measured in hundreds rather than hundreds of thousands.
details.caption: Details matter.
awards.title: Awarded for what is inside the bottle.
human.title: Made at human scale.
human.copy: There is no château, and no marketing department. There is a small wine house in Cricău, and editions counted in hundreds and low thousands of bottles. These photographs are not a campaign. They are what it looks like.
human.docCap1: the stall, vinul județului Alba, before the photographer arrives

order.copy: Our wines are available to order directly from the wine house. To place an order, contact us by telephone. We will be delighted to help you choose your wines, confirm availability and arrange your order.
